blockers: ASCCLI Apple web authentication required to pull and stage privacy declarations.
1.1.0 build 3 is WAITING_FOR_REVIEW and does not contain Clans; no editable Clans app info exists.
publication: Stage privacy as unpublished draft after authenticating; publish with the Clans submission. Preserve the existing submission and all unrelated declarations.

reasoning.userGeneratedContent: Members share profile names, photos and clan names.
reasoning.messagingAndChat: Preset nudges and cheers communicate between members.
reasoning.contests: Repeatable fitness challenges and rankings are a central Clans feature; no wagering or prizes required by Apple definition.

ageRating.commandTemplate: asc age-rating edit --app-info-id CLANS_APP_INFO_ID --user-generated-content true --messaging-and-chat true --health-or-wellness-topics true --contests FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE
ageRating.remainingAssessment: Keep socialMedia false for private invite-only groups without a public discovery/amplification feed. Reassess if product behavior changes. Do not infer age-assurance API use from a self-entered birthday.

notes.Health/Fitness: Calorie-goal and weight-change percentages are linked to the account; preserve existing Health declaration.
notes.Other Data Types: Birth month/year stored for weight-challenge eligibility.
notes.Emails or Text Messages: Stored nudge/cheer sender, recipient and message kind; Apple includes non-SMS in-app messages.
notes.Customer Support: Moderation reports and reasons are retained for support/safety.
notes.Contacts: Clan membership and blocks form an account-linked social graph; no device address book access.
notes.User ID marketing: Used with email address to select opted-in subscribers and generate unsubscribe links.

manifestFollowUp: App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy currently lacks Name and Email Address; reconcile the native manifest with final declarations before archiving Clans.
